name: Lisa
request: One bolt rises from Lisa palm, then one bolt strikes every occupied enemy-card position simultaneously.
motion: Clamped Bezier gathering and decelerating sparks, one-frame accelerated leaders, asymmetric width-dissolve restrikes. No uniform beam grow/shrink cycle.
look: Irregular tapered white-lavender channels, violet corona, separately flashing forks and alternate restrike filaments; short contact flare, broken shock arcs, drifting sparks.
layout: Reference card centers follow the current 1920x1080 nine-card layout; slot numbers 1..5 run right-to-left.

exports.Lisa_CastUp.fbx: Fixed approximate palm origin; gather then one upward snap, frames 1..18.
exports.Lisa_LightningStrike.fbx: Local hit origin; one-frame top-to-bottom leader and contact burst; contact local frame 2, frames 1..32.
exports.Lisa_VioletArc_AllEnemies.fbx: Five-slot reference animation, all targets contact on frame 20; no cards, cameras or controllers.

runtimeContract: Use a fixed approximate hand-area source; no hand tracking is needed. Host supplies occupied enemy anchors. Reuse one strike per actual enemy and share its impact time. Empty slots receive no effect.
material: All effect meshes retain VFXColor RGBA. Blender materials and compositor bloom are authoring previews, not Unity materials.
scope: Art assets only; not yet bound to formal Unity combat.

referenceCardCompletion.frontsAndFrames: Existing nine meshes and transforms preserved.
referenceCardCompletion.backs: Nine rounded default card backs, packed UI_Gcg_CardBack_01.png.
referenceCardCompletion.edges: Nine rounded reference shells, 0.048 m plus tiny rear-depth separation; attached to existing frame parenting.
referenceCardCompletion.exportScope: Reference geometry is excluded from effect exports; existing FBX files unchanged.
